title: Cumulative Integration Gate Result Schema
description: integration-gate-result/v1 (SW-1511A-INTEGRATION-001). The product schema that replaces the controller-measured interim integration-gate-result.json. One source-bound decision: a cumulative test manifest, the source-suite and installed-wheel totals with their skips, the environment digest and the candidate SHA. A complete-suite result for a different candidate SHA can never authorize final-head integration.

schema.description: The exact product schema identity. Anything else is refused.

candidate_sha.description: Canonical lowercase full 40-hex SHA of the exact candidate under integration.

base_sha.description: The frozen base the candidate diff is taken against.

manifest.description: The cumulative test manifest: the union of base, diff-derived and prior-accepted-surface test files.

skips.description: Skip counts kept explicit and separate from passes.

environment_digest.description: The digest binding this result to the attested execution environment (the execution-environment-attestation/v1 dependency-lock digest).

tasks.description: The accepted task surfaces the cumulative manifest folds in.

review_read_only.description: True only when the candidate tree digest was unchanged across review: review mutated nothing.

verdict.description: pass authorizes final-head integration for candidate_sha; refused never does.

refusals.description: The named reasons a refused result is not authorized. A passing result carries none.
